debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0 = none, 1 = minimal, 2 = verbose).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections allowed per client IP address.

idle_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before an idle connection is closed.

auth_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for authentication.

starttls_enabled.description: Enable STARTTLS extension for opportunistic encryption.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate chain file (PEM format).

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format).

tls_min_protocol.description: Minimum acceptable TLS protocol version (e.g., "1.2" or "1.3").

tls_ciphers.description: OpenSSL-style cipher list (restrict to strong ciphers).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable native SSL/TLS on IMAPS port (993).

listen_addresses.description: List of addresses and ports to bind to. Each entry specifies the IP address, port, and whether SSL/TLS is enabled.

port.description: TCP port number (e.g., 143 for IMAP, 993 for IMAPS).

ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for this listener.

auth_mechs.description: Ordered list of SASL authentication mechanisms to offer (e.g., 'PLAIN', 'LOGIN', 'DIGEST-MD5').

maildir_enabled.description: Use Maildir format for mailboxes instead of mbox.

mailbase.description: Base directory where user mailboxes are stored.

mailspool.description: Directory containing user mail spool files.

enable_sieve.description: Enable Sieve script support (e.g., for server-side filtering).

sieve_dir.description: Directory for user-specific Sieve scripts (if enabled).

sieve_global_dir.description: Directory for global Sieve scripts (if enabled).

log_level.description: Syslog log level (0-7; 7 = debug). Set to 0 to disable detailed syslog logging.

log_file.description: Path to log file (if not using syslog).

pam_service.description: PAM service name for authentication (if using PAM).

chroot_dir.description: Chroot jail directory (empty string = no chroot).

run_user.description: User account to drop privileges to after startup.

run_group.description: Group to use for dropped privileges.
